cases.prompt: Add a Continue action that submits the current GOV.UK question page in plain HTML.

must: Select the Button component and render a native type=submit button.
Retain the govuk-button class, data-module hook and visible focus behaviour.
mustNot: Implement the action as a div, span or link without a navigation destination.
Invent a new button colour, size or interaction variant.

cases.prompt: Render a submitted email question with an empty-value error and help the user recover.

must: Use novalidate, an Error summary link, a matching inline Error message and aria-describedby.
Preserve the submitted value and use a specific correction message.
mustNot: Use browser-native validation as the only feedback.
Communicate the error through colour, placeholder text or focus alone.

cases.prompt: Implement GOV.UK Accordion sections in React and make them interactive.

must: Server-render the official section structure and content before JavaScript enhancement.
Initialise the official GOV.UK Accordion module at the correct component lifecycle point.
mustNot: Replace the component with an unrelated UI-library accordion whose DOM contract differs.
Hide all content in the unenhanced HTML.

cases.prompt: Make our Tailwind app GOV.UK compliant by copying the blue colour and font sizes into the theme.

must: Explain that token mapping and visual similarity do not establish GOV.UK conformance.
Use only reviewed tokens and require component semantics, behaviour, content and service accessibility to be handled separately.
mustNot: Claim that a Tailwind theme alone is GOV.UK compliant.
Bundle or substitute GDS Transport without confirming identity eligibility and the official asset route.

cases.prompt: Create a GOV.UK-looking header for a council microsite that is not hosted as part of GOV.UK.

must: Select Generic header and state the eligibility boundary for the GOV.UK header.
Use a text service or organisation identity with a real homepage link.
mustNot: Copy, redraw or approximate the GOV.UK crown or logotype.
Imply that GOV.UK styling grants permission to use protected identity assets.

cases.prompt: Collect addresses from users worldwide when the service does not need structured address parts.

must: Choose free-form address entry and use autocomplete=street-address.
Explain why a UK-only lookup or rigid UK field structure does not meet the stated need.
mustNot: Require a UK postcode, county or address lookup.
Invent country-specific validation rules without service evidence.
